lead_raw_text:
The structure of Cs8Tl4Au4Cl24 (reduced formula Cs2TlAuCl6) crystallizes in the cubic space group Fm-3m (No. 225), with 40 atoms per unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies octahedral environments for Au and Tl, each coordinated by six Cl neighbors, while Cs shows a close-packed-like local arrangement with 12 Cl neighbors. The periodic neighbor graph is three-dimensional and fully connected across all 40 sites. Corner-sharing between Au and Tl octahedra is observed, alongside face-sharing between Cs 12-vertex polyhedra and both Au and Tl octahedra.
